question: In a parallelogram, the length of its two adjacent parallel sides are 11.9 cm and a cm where a is the smaller side. If the perpendicular distance between the two longer and shorter sides are 3.9 cm and 5.1 cm, find the perimeter of the parallelogram.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of parallelogram = base × height (same for both pairs of sides)

11.9 × 3.9 = a × 5.1

a = (11.9 × 3.9) ÷ 5.1 = 9.1 cm

Perimeter = 2(11.9 + 9.1)

**∴ Answer = 42 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One side = 11.9 cm, other side = a cm

Perpendicular distances = 3.9 cm and 5.1 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of parallelogram = base × height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area using longer side = 11.9 × 3.9

⇒ Area using shorter side = a × 5.1

⇒ Equating areas ⇒ 11.9 × 3.9 = a × 5.1

⇒ a = (11.9 × 3.9) ÷ 5.1

⇒ a = 46.41 ÷ 5.1 = 9.1 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 2(11.9 + 9.1)

⇒ = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Parallelogram Area Property

Area remains same irrespective of chosen base: Area = base × corresponding height.

Perimeter Formula

Perimeter = 2 × (sum of adjacent sides).

Opposite Sides

In a parallelogram, opposite sides are equal and parallel.
